title: Bard creation blocked: class skill choice 'Choose any three' (any:true) has no options
description: class:bard skillChoices = [{text:'Choose any three', any:true, choose:3}] with no from; requiredChoices.ts structuredProficiencyChoice passes from: undefined, so the wizard offers no options and a Bard cannot finish creation. Found by eshyra-n7ls.1 (Haiku). Fix: an 'any' skill choice offers SRD_5_1_SKILLS (srdCreationChoices.ts, the open 'skills of your choice' universe).
